description: Digital partition testbenches: the readout cocotb bench (rtl/readout/, spec rows 5 and 6) and the two klt functional-verification requests that drive it -- the pre-layout run cited as 5.digital and the SDF-annotated post-route re-run cited as 7.digital. The cold start is the documented entry point `make -C verification/readout` (check_env, Verilator lint -Wall, then the full cocotb suite on Icarus); it reproduces the pre-layout run in full. The SDF re-run is NOT re-executed: request-sdf.json names host-absolute PDK timing-model and SDF paths (verification/README.md), so a third party adjusts them for their own install.
